atoms.a: On the internet you can follow these basic rules:
atoms.b: • I won’t ((believe)) everything I see on the internet.
• I won’t answer ((emails)) or open attachments from strangers.
• I will be very careful with my ((personal_data)). I’ll also be ((careful)) with other people’s data.
• If something seems strange, or I don’t know enough about it, I’ll ask an ((adult)).

atoms.a: Harry wants to participate in a chatroom. Which of the following usernames would be the safest?
John wants to sign up for a basketball forum. Which of the following passwords would be the safest?
Matilda signed up for a giveaway with her email address. Now she keeps receiving emails from unknown senders. How should she deal with this?

instruction.text: Which of these things help with being safer on the internet? Drag them onto the computer screen.
What types of dangers on the internet do these actions count as? Drag them to the correct groups.

atoms.b: being bullied by classmates on social media
being insulted by an anonymous person
